rules: Collapsed output must preserve a primary identifier.
Blocked and denied outcomes must expose the affected identifier without requiring expansion.
Workspace paths should be rendered relative to the workspace.
Multiple targets should show a bounded sample and a remaining-count suffix.
Glob and Grep should expose the pattern, not file contents.
Duplicate basenames must retain enough parent context to remain distinguishable.
Expanded mode may add details but may not be the only place where object identity exists.

permitted: The public issue supports a missing-primary-identifier product contract.
The reference renderer satisfies the proposed bounded acceptance matrix.
The issue should remain open until current-product behavior is verified against the contract.
forbidden: The current Claude Code implementation was source-audited.
The issue is fixed in the current release.
The reference renderer is the actual Claude Code renderer.
Boris or Anthropic must adopt the proposed exact UI wording.
